items.title: Hawkeye Featured on Mikey Spice’s ‘Spice Rock 2’ Project
items.body:
Big news dropping straight from the heart of the culture! 🔥 Veteran Dancehall deejay Hawkeye is back in the spotlight, bringing his signature flow to Mikey Spice's brand new project, 'Spice Rock 2'! Hawkeye himself hit the gram with pure fire, letting the whole world know this highly anticipated collaboration is out now on all digital platforms. It's clear the excitement is real when an artist is this hyped to share their work with the masses!

This isn't just another feature; it's a powerful link-up between two stalwarts of Jamaican music, hinting at the continued evolution of the 'Spice Rock' series. Hawkeye gave a special shout-out to Mikey Spice and Andrea Bullens, acknowledging the hands that brought this musical moment to life. While Ms. Bullens' exact role remains under wraps, her mention alongside the legendary Mikey Spice speaks volumes about her contribution to this exciting new chapter. Get ready to feel the riddim!

items.title: Jimmy Cliff’s spirit electrifies Montego Bay’s Hip Strip
items.body:
The word from the streets, verified by the Jamaica Gleaner, is that the legendary Jimmy Cliff's indomitable spirit is once again setting Montego Bay's Hip Strip ablaze! This isn't just news; it's a powerful testament to the enduring presence and magnetic energy of a true reggae pioneer whose influence continues to resonate deep within the heart of Jamaica.

From his groundbreaking work in 'The Harder They Come' to his timeless anthems that have touched souls worldwide, Cliff's contribution to reggae and global music is simply immeasurable. This electrifying vibe in MoBay reminds us all that the roots of our culture run deep, constantly inspiring new generations and keeping the authentic reggae fire burning bright for the world to witness. Respect due to a living legend!

items.title: Shaggy & Rayvon’s cover of ‘Angel’, scores double platinum in UK
items.body:
Big up to the legendary Shaggy and the smooth vocals of Rayvon! Their iconic cover of 'Angel' has officially soared to double platinum status in the UK, a massive achievement that continues to cement its place in music history. This track, a global sensation from the early 2000s, proves that authentic reggae and dancehall rhythms have an undeniable, timeless appeal that resonates across continents.

This isn't just a win for the artists; it's a monumental moment for Jamaican music on the international stage. 'Angel' showcased the genre's incredible ability to cross boundaries and capture hearts worldwide, solidifying Shaggy's legacy as a true global ambassador for our culture. This double platinum certification is a powerful testament to the enduring influence and commercial success of reggae and dancehall, inspiring generations to come.

items.title: Sean Paul and King Jammy’s Sleng Teng Cut ‘Stand On Business’ Hits 7-Inch Vinyl
items.body:
Hold tight, massive! The Dutty Rock general himself, Sean Paul, is stepping back to the foundational riddim that forever changed Jamaican music. We're talking about the legendary Sleng Teng, and who better to steer the ship than the architect of its digital revolution, King Jammy! Their highly anticipated new single, "Stand On Business," is set to drop on a classic 7-inch vinyl, a true nod to sound system culture, with Jammy's instrumental version on the flip for all the selectors out there.

This isn't just a new tune; it's a monumental tribute to the roots of digital dancehall, bringing together an undisputed global superstar with the visionary who sparked the genre's electronic era back in '85 with Wayne Smith's "Under Mi Sleng Teng." This powerful collaboration, listed by VP Records on the JAM imprint, promises to be a crucial piece of history, landing on November 27, 2026. Get ready to feel the bass and witness history in the making!

items.title: Valiant Says Dancehall Lost Its Feeling, and His Next Project “Motivation To Myself” Is His Answer
items.body:
Massive respect to Valiant for stepping forward and voicing what many in the Dancehall massive have been feeling! He openly admits that the music sometimes lacks that authentic *feeling* it once had, that something real got lost along the way. This isn't just an artist complaining; it's a profound acknowledgment from one of the genre's leading voices, showing he's deeply connected to the pulse of the culture and ready to address the call for deeper vibes.

His answer? The highly anticipated project, "Motivation To Myself." Valiant is deliberately charting a course away from fleeting trends, aiming to deliver music that truly "breathes" and offers solace when life gets heavy. If you're eager for a taste of this conscious direction, check out the powerful singles "Time Capsule," "Coverage," and "Bless Me Account." While the full project is slated for 2027, Valiant assures us this "positive project loading soon" will be worth the wait, promising a much-needed injection of soul and substance back into the Dancehall landscape.

items.title: Capleton Announces New Jersey Show at NJPAC on Thanksgiving Weekend
items.body:
The Prophet Capleton is set to ignite the stage in Newark, New Jersey, proving the holidays are no time to cool down! The legendary Fireman himself announced via Instagram that he'll be mashing up NJPAC on Friday, November 27, 2026, the night after Thanksgiving. Get ready for pure energy as doors open at 7 PM and the show kicks off at 8 PM – tickets are already blazing on Ticketmaster!

Capleton, known as King Shango, consistently delivers an electrifying performance, embodying the true spirit of conscious dancehall with his signature "Hot up dah place yah" energy. This NJPAC date is a testament to his enduring power and the global reach of authentic reggae culture. And for those with keen eyes, his post also tagged #tarrusriley, sparking exciting speculation about potential collaborations – stay tuned for more details on what promises to be an unforgettable night!

items.title: Spice Asserts ‘Queen of Dancehall’ Status During City Splash Set in London Amid Shenseea Controversy
items.body:
The Queen of Dancehall, Spice, left no doubt in anyone's mind at the City Splash Indoor Festival in London this past Saturday! Performing for a massive 15,000-strong crowd, Spice took the audience on a journey back to her humble beginnings, recalling days of walking miles to hand out CDs and clashing with men on stage. This powerful reflection set the stage for her undeniable assertion of her reign, reminding everyone of the grit and grind that built her empire.

With the energy electric, Spice declared her pivotal role in shaping the culture, stating, "I, Grace Hamilton, did that," referring to her pioneering efforts in convincing selectors to create "gyal segments." This moment was a masterclass in asserting legacy, a bold statement cementing her foundational impact on Dancehall. Her message was clear: respect the journey, respect the crown, or face the consequences. This isn't just about a title; it's about acknowledging the trailblazer who paved the way for so many.

items.title: Skillibeng keeps his focus on Cya Stop The G
items.body:
The East Syde General, Skillibeng, continues to demonstrate his unwavering dedication to the craft, with reports confirming his laser focus on the project "Cya Stop The G." This consistent grind is a testament to his commitment to pushing boundaries and delivering authentic, hard-hitting dancehall to the massive worldwide. Skillibeng's unique flow and lyrical prowess have solidified his spot at the forefront of the genre, and this renewed focus signals more fire to come.

For the culture, this news is a powerful reminder of the relentless spirit that defines reggae and dancehall. An artist like Skillibeng, staying true to his vision and investing deeply in his work, ensures the continuous evolution and strength of our music. It’s about more than just tunes; it's about the message, the resilience, and the unstoppable force of Jamaican creativity. Keep your ears to the ground, massive, because when Skillibeng focuses, the whole world feels the impact!

items.title: Popcaan touts ‘fastest’ sold-out Barclays Center concert in dancehall
items.body:
🚨 POPCAAN MAKES HISTORY AT BARCLAYS! The Unruly Boss, Popcaan, is making waves across the globe, proudly declaring his recent Barclays Center concert as the fastest sold-out dancehall show ever at the iconic Brooklyn venue. This is a monumental achievement for the St. Thomas deejay, solidifying his status as a global force and proving the undeniable power of authentic Jamaican music.

This isn't just a win for Popcaan; it's a massive triumph for Dancehall culture worldwide! From the streets of Jamaica to the heart of Brooklyn, the Unruly King is proving that our vibrant sound continues to break barriers and captivate massive audiences, pushing our genre further into the mainstream while staying true to its roots. Big up the Unruly Camp!

items.title: Chronixx Rub A Dub Session in New York This Saturday With Kelissa and Tippy I Grade
items.body:
New York City, get ready! 🗽 The word is out, and it's pure fire! 🔥 Chronixx, the lyrical prophet himself, is set to ignite a "rub a dub SUPERNOVA session" this Saturday in the Big Apple, alongside the soulful Kelissa and the masterful Tippy I Grade. As Runkus declared, "NEW YORK NEW YORK, rasta deh ya, this saturday. we live." This isn't just a show; it's a spiritual gathering of some of the most vital voices in modern roots reggae.

This powerful lineup is a testament to the generation that has fearlessly pulled authentic roots reggae back into the global spotlight over the past decade. With deep Rastafari roots running through each artist, expect nothing less than conscious vibrations, heavy basslines, and uplifting messages that resonate deep within the soul. Don't miss your chance to witness history in the making – tickets are available now via chronixx.com. Forward ever!

items.title: Spice Challenges Shenseea’s ‘Queen of Dancehall’ Claim; Shenseea Responds With ‘Bad Alone’
items.body:
The Dancehall arena is buzzing, massive! The coveted 'Queen of Dancehall' title has once again ignited a fiery debate, with Shenseea making a bold claim at Miami's 103.5 The Beat. While giving veteran Spice her well-deserved flowers for her contributions, Shenseea asserted the crown is hers based on current statistics and accomplishments. But Spice, ever the formidable force, was quick to push back in an Instagram video, questioning Shenseea's true impact on the genre and dismissing streaming numbers as the sole measure, highlighting how collaborations can skew the picture.

Shenseea's subtle, yet potent, response has the culture talking! No diss track was dropped; instead, she delivered a masterclass in digital shade: a yawning emoji, a stalk of callaloo, and a link to her 2020 track "Bad Alone." The lyric "Gyal haffi bundle up like a seh dem a callaloo. Bad alone dat a di truth. Plus a bare bad gyal roll inna mi crew" suddenly gave that vegetable post a whole new meaning! This isn't just a clash; it's a vibrant display of Dancehall's competitive spirit, where lyrical wit and cultural references keep the conversation around legacy, impact, and who truly wears the crown burning bright.

items.title: Iley Dread ends 15 year-year Jamaican stage absence with genre-spanning ‘Upliftment’ album
items.body:
Massive news for the culture! Toronto-based singer and producer Iley Dread, born Colin Levy, is making a triumphant return to Jamaican stages after a 15-year hiatus! The highly anticipated homecoming will see him launch his seventh album, 'Upliftment', on January 6 at Kingston’s Louise Bennett Garden Theatre. This is more than just an album launch; it's a significant moment for an artist reconnecting with his roots and bringing a fresh, expansive sound back to the island where it all began.

'Upliftment' is set to be a groundbreaking journey, showcasing Iley Dread's versatility with a vibrant mix of country, Afrobeats, ska, and classic reggae vibes across its 14 tracks. Featuring heavyweight covers like Kenny Rogers and Dolly Parton’s "Islands In The Stream" and Sam Cooke’s "Wonderful World," alongside a powerful collaboration with reggae queen Marcia Griffiths on "Love Me Forever," this album promises to push boundaries. His Kings Of Kings Productions is ready to deliver a project that truly embodies musical evolution and upliftment for all. Respect due!

items.title: Shenseea and Skillibeng Set to Release New Collaboration Produced by Silent Addy and Disco Neil
items.body:
The dancehall world was ablaze this past weekend, not just with the Kingston sun, but with a viral video of Shenseea and Skillibeng vibing on a yacht at Lime Cay. While timelines were split between romance rumors and music video speculation, Cool & Deadly Reggae can confirm the real talk: a massive new collaboration is on the way! This highly anticipated link-up features two of the genre's most dynamic forces, Shenseea and Skillibeng, with production duties handled by the formidable Silent Addy and Disco Neil. This is more than just a track; it's a strategic move set to ignite the airwaves and solidify their positions at the forefront of global dancehall.

This union of Shenseea's undeniable star power and Skillibeng's raw, cutting-edge flow promises to deliver an anthem that will resonate from Kingston to the world. Both artists consistently push boundaries, and their combined energy under the guidance of Silent Addy and Disco Neil is guaranteed to be a game-changer for the culture. This is how buzz is built, and this is how legends are made. Get ready for a serious musical impact – the streets are watching, and the sound system is ready!

items.title: House Of Dread – Dahvid Slur (Music Video)
items.body:
Massive news from the heart of Trench Town! Dahvid Slur, a true torchbearer for authentic roots reggae from the New Age Rockaz camp, has just unleashed the powerful music video for his latest single, "House of Dread." This incredible tune sets the stage as the very first taste from his highly anticipated debut album, signaling a profound return to the foundational sounds that uplift and inspire.

The vibrations are undeniably strong, with heavyweight production from the esteemed I Grade Records, Zion I Kings, and Teflon Zincfence, ensuring a sound that resonates deep within the soul. Dahvid Slur continues to solidify his position as one of the most genuine voices in contemporary roots music, pushing forward the culture with integrity and conscious message. This is essential listening for all who cherish the authentic reggae spirit!

items.title: Vybz Kartel Drops ‘Portfolio’ Audio, Keeps the Rollout In-House
items.body:
The Teacha has spoken! Vybz Kartel, the Worl'Boss himself, just unleashed his latest track, "Portfolio," with zero fanfare and maximum impact. True to his iconic style, Kartel dropped the audio with a direct, no-frills Instagram post: "#portfolio Audio out now. Stream on All Platforms & on VYBZKARTELVEVO." No long talk, no drawn-out teasers – just pure, unadulterated dancehall from the Gaza don, proving once again he sets his own rules.

This strategic move highlights Kartel's continued mastery of the digital landscape. With camera work credited to @sidemozturk and editing by his own @vybzkarteltv, it's clear the visual rollout is staying firmly in the family. Directing fans to VYBZKARTELVEVO ensures all eyes (and clicks!) stay on his official channel, a smart play in today's streaming era. While the "audio" tag leaves us wondering if a full video is on the horizon, one thing's for sure: Kartel continues to innovate and dominate, keeping the culture vibrant and on its toes.

items.title: Capelton’s Cousin Jah Thunder Set for First-Ever Ghana Show at Ghana Jam Fest
items.body:
Big news resonating across the diaspora! Gramps Morgan of Morgan Heritage just dropped a bombshell, announcing that Jah Thunder, cousin to the legendary 'Prophet' Capelton, is set to blaze the stage at Ghana Jam Fest! Straight outta Jamaica, this marks Jah Thunder's highly anticipated first-ever performance in Ghana, a move that promises to ignite a powerful cultural bridge between the motherland and the island's vibrant sound.

This family link is pure fire, giving Jah Thunder an immediate heavyweight stamp of approval in the global reggae and dancehall arena. With Capelton's decades-long legacy as a conscious firebrand and the voice behind anthems like "Tour," the connection ensures Jah Thunder steps onto the Accra stage with serious anticipation. This isn't just a performance; it's a crucial forward movement, uniting Jamaican riddims with Ghana's own rich musical tapestry, signaling an exciting new chapter for the culture!

items.title: Beres Hammond and friends to spread joy at Love Note concert
items.body:
Big up the Maestro, Beres Hammond, who is once again set to bless the airwaves and stages, this time with his "friends" at the highly anticipated Love Note concert! The King of Lovers Rock consistently delivers pure, unadulterated musical joy, a true testament to the enduring power and positive vibrations of authentic reggae. This is more than just a show; it's a spiritual upliftment from one of our culture's most cherished icons.

This development is a powerful reminder of the foundation and heart of reggae music. Beres Hammond's commitment to spreading good vibes and love through his timeless melodies continues to inspire generations. Expect nothing but irie energy and soulful performances that will resonate deep within the reggae and dancehall community. We give thanks for artists who keep the culture vibrant and the message strong!

items.title: ‘Panic is my Chris Blackwell’: Wyclef’s Kingston connection fuels reggae album
items.body:
Massive news hitting the airwaves, family! The legendary Wyclef Jean, a true global music icon known for his groundbreaking work with The Fugees and a stellar solo career, is reportedly deep in the heart of Kingston, Jamaica, crafting a brand new reggae album! Wyclef himself declared, "Panic is my Chris Blackwell," signaling a profound and authentic connection to the island's musical roots that promises to deliver something truly special and deeply connected to the culture.

This isn't just another project; it's a powerful endorsement of reggae's enduring influence and global reach. With a visionary like Wyclef tapping into the vibrant energy of Kingston and drawing inspiration from figures he likens to the iconic Chris Blackwell, we can anticipate a fresh, yet deeply rooted, sound that will resonate worldwide. Get ready for a forward movement that celebrates the authentic spirit of Jamaican music!

items.title: Gage vs Dancehall: The One-Sided Wars of a Clarendon Firebrand
items.body:
Massive respect to DancehallMag for shedding light on the unique journey of Clarendon's own Gage, Ryan Douglas. For nearly a decade, while many artistes sought out a rival, Gage took on the *entire* Dancehall industry! From calling out superstars and producers who wouldn't voice him, to challenging an entire generation he believes has lost its way, Gage has consistently voiced his convictions, making his story one for the books.

Now, we all know Dancehall thrives on clash culture – a lyric demands an answer, and the dancefloor decides the victor. But Gage's battles rarely became the back-and-forth lyrical showdowns we expect. Unlike the legendary, island-splitting Gaza vs Gully feud that burned for decades, Gage's wars mostly remained one-sided. This unique approach highlights how some lyrical fires blaze for years, while others, despite their intensity, never quite catch the wider flame, offering a fascinating look into the dynamics of our beloved culture.

items.title: From ‘Housewives’ Shade to Dancehall: Vybz Kartel Joins the ‘Low Budget’ Boom
items.body:
The streets are talking, and now the airwaves are buzzing! What started as a fiery clash between reality TV star Karen Loderick-Peace and Amanda Cronin on Real Housewives of London has blossomed into a full-blown dancehall phenomenon. Loderick-Peace's viral takedown about "low budget" property portfolios has sparked a miniature music industry, and none other than the Teacha himself, Vybz Kartel, has stepped into the arena. Alongside Chambah, Kartel has unleashed "Low Budget Vagina," adding his inimitable voice to a rapidly growing collection of tracks inspired by the iconic exchange. This is dancehall's raw, real-time commentary at its finest!

This development perfectly showcases dancehall's unparalleled ability to capture, dissect, and amplify cultural moments with lightning speed. Vybz Kartel, ever the trendsetter, proves once again why he remains at the forefront, turning viral social commentary into undeniable riddims. It's a testament to the genre's dynamism – taking everyday conversations about wealth, status, and social dynamics, and transforming them into high-energy, high-impact musical statements. The budget might be low, but the output and cultural resonance are undeniably massive!
